name: Aokie Voice (Speech-to-Text + Text-to-Speech)
description: Local speech service backed by the Aokie voice stack: NVIDIA Parakeet ONNX speech-to-text and pocket-tts ONNX text-to-speech — the same engines the Aokie phone receptionist uses, exposed as OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoints (POST /v1/audio/transcriptions and /v1/audio/speech) on a loopback port for FormLogic Flows' Transcribe audio / Speak text steps. The server binary ships with the Aokie plugin (aokie-voice-server.exe next to aokie-plugin.exe); install the Aokie plugin in the Plugins tab first, and it reuses the plugin's ONNX Runtime and voice models. Models load lazily on first request (STT ~600 MB, TTS ~200 MB RAM).
